_note: Knowledge base for KrishiChain Bharat. Doses are based on standard extension-style guidance; ALWAYS follow the product label and confirm with the local KVK / agriculture officer before spraying.

early_blight.name: Early blight (Alternaria solani)
early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown concentric-ring spots ('target board') on older leaves, yellowing around spots.
organic: Remove and destroy affected lower leaves
Spray Trichoderma viride 5 g/L or neem oil 3 ml/L + sticky spreader
Copper oxychloride 3 g/L (also accepted in organic-leaning plans)
cultural: Rotate away from solanaceous crops next season
early_blight.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Tomato Crop Protection)

late_blight.name: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans)
late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked greasy patches turning brown-black, white fuzzy growth underneath in humid weather; fast spreading.
organic: Remove infected plants/leaves immediately and bury away from field
Preventive copper oxychloride 3 g/L on healthy plants
cultural: Do not move tools/labour from infected to healthy plots
late_blight.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Tomato Crop Protection)

leaf_curl_virus.name: Tomato leaf curl virus (whitefly-transmitted)
leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, yellowing, stunted plants; whiteflies under leaves.
organic: Yellow sticky traps (about 10 per 1000 sq m)
Neem oil 3-5 ml/L or neem seed kernel extract 5% against whitefly
Uproot and destroy severely infected plants

chemical.active: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (vector control only; virus itself cannot be cured)

cultural: Border crop of maize/sorghum as barrier
leaf_curl_virus.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Tomato Crop Protection)

bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot (Xanthomonas)
bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, often with yellow halo; worse after rain.
organic: Remove infected leaves
Copper oxychloride 3 g/L spray
bacterial_spot.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Tomato Crop Protection)

fusarium_wilt.name: Fusarium wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici)
fusarium_wilt.symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaves on one side of shoot, daytime wilting, vascular browning inside stem.
organic: Soil application of Trichoderma harzianum @ 2.5 kg/ha mixed with 50 kg farm yard manure
Neem cake soil amendment @ 250 kg/ha

powdery_mildew.name: Powdery mildew (Leveillula taurica)
powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on lower and upper leaf surfaces, followed by chlorosis and leaf drying.
organic: Spray wettable sulphur 80% WP @ 2 g/L
Neem oil 3 ml/L spray at first appearance of symptoms
cultural: Ensure good field ventilation and spacing

purple_blotch.name: Purple blotch (Alternaria porri)
purple_blotch.symptoms: Small white sunken lesions that enlarge into purple-brown blotches with yellow edges on leaves and flower stalks.
organic: Remove badly affected leaves
Neem oil 3 ml/L with sticky spreader
Trichoderma viride 5 g/L
purple_blotch.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Onion Crop Protection)

downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew (Peronospora destructor)
downy_mildew.symptoms: Pale elongated patches on leaves with greyish-violet fuzz in cool humid weather; leaves collapse.
organic: Remove infected foliage
Copper oxychloride 3 g/L preventive spray
downy_mildew.source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Horticulture - Onion Crop Protection)

stemphylium_blight.name: Stemphylium leaf blight (Stemphylium vesicarium)
stemphylium_blight.symptoms: Small yellow to orange spots on leaves, rapidly developing into elongated brown to dark olive necrotic lesions.
organic: Trichoderma viride 5 g/L spray
Neem formulation spray 3 ml/L with adjuvant
cultural: Maintain balanced potassium and nitrogen levels
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation during high humidity

basal_rot.name: Basal rot / Bulb rot (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cepae)
basal_rot.symptoms: Yellowing and drying of leaves starting from the tips, decaying of root-stem plate and softening of bulb base.
organic: Bulb / seedling dip in Trichoderma viride suspension (10 g/L) before planting
Soil application of neem cake @ 200 kg/ha
cultural: Careful harvesting to avoid bulb injury

black_mould.name: Black mould rot (Aspergillus niger)
black_mould.symptoms: Black powdery spores along veins and under outer dry scales of onion bulbs, soft rot during storage.
organic: Proper field curing of onions under shade with good ventilation
Spray biocontrol Pseudomonas fluorescens 5 g/L before harvest
cultural: Thorough drying and curing before storage
Store bulbs in well-ventilated, cool, dry structures
